deviations.difference: The fixture is a small synthetic C# review target rather than a SARD test case.
deviations.reason: A compact hidden manifest isolates review recall and is redistributable with this repository.

deviations.difference: A finding matches by file, line neighborhood, and semantic keywords instead of a tool-specific alert taxonomy.
deviations.reason: The same response contract must work for general-purpose reviewing models without exposing seed identifiers.

task.prompt: Review the source files in this workspace for concrete correctness, security, and reliability defects. Do not modify files. Return only JSON with this shape: {"findings":[{"file":"path","line":1,"severity":"critical|high|medium|low","title":"short title","summary":"why this is a defect","evidence":"specific behavior"}]}. Report only actionable defects; line is the most relevant source line.
